FAQ

How much does an AI receptionist cost for an electrical contractor?Published entry prices in our directory run from $29/mo (Dialzara, 60 minutes) and $49/mo (OnCrew 100 calls, Rosie 250 minutes, or ServiceAgent Core) up to $199/mo for unlimited calls (NextPhone). Smith.ai and ServiceAgent both have free entry tiers.
Which tools list electricians as a fit?OnCrew and ServiceAgent both list electricians. Rosie and Smith.ai list contractors or home services more broadly. Housecall Pro and FieldPulse list electricians on the scheduling side if you also need dispatch software.
What should an electrical shop prioritize?After-hours coverage and a clear emergency handoff. Panel trips and no-power calls often come at night. Confirm the vendor can escalate emergencies to your on-call tech, not only take a message.
